Hand-written thesis overrides. scripts/build-theses.js merges these on top of its auto-extracted output. Use for companies where pdftotext mangled the source or the auto-extracted sentence quoted a metadata line. Each entry can swap specific brokers' houseViews (via _replaceHouseViews) or replace the bull/bear paragraph blocks. Paragraphs are split by \n\n in the output; each becomes its own

in the renderer. Citation marker syntax: [CITE:Broker|YYMMDD|encodeURIComponent(url)|page]. Bolding policy: highlight meaningful claim phrases (targets, rating actions, drivers, beat/miss with context), NOT bare numbers / FY labels / bps figures.

houseViews.paragraph: Kotak reads the FY26 annual report as proof that **ADSEZ's investment cycle has stepped up** — standalone investments and loans-and-advances ran at roughly 3x the FY20-25 annual pace, funded largely from operating cash flow rather than incremental debt. They view the **balance-sheet-led capex as the key set-up for the next leg of cargo-volume and EBITDA growth**, and reiterate **ADD with a Fair Value of ₹1,900**.

Adani Ports and SEZ.bullParagraph:
Jefferies sees ADSEZ as **confident of achieving its 1bn-tonne cargo target by 2030** (16% CAGR vs Jefferies' own 13% baseline), with organic growth in domestic ports and existing international capacity doing most of the heavy lifting before brownfield expansion at Mundra, Vizhinjam and Hazira kicks in. [CITE:Jeff|260604|file%3A%2F%2F%2FC%3A%2FUsers%2Fadmin%2FDesktop%2FIndia%2520Related%2520Reports%2FAdani%2520Ports%2520and%2520SEZ%2F%255B260604%255D%2520%255BJefferies%255D%2520Adani%2520Ports%2520and%2520SEZ%2520-%2520Management%2520Meet%2520Takeaways.pdf|1]

Kotak reads the FY26 annual report as proof that **ADSEZ's investment cycle has stepped up** — standalone investments and loans-and-advances ran at roughly 3x the FY20-25 annual pace, funded largely from internal accruals rather than incremental debt. They see this **balance-sheet-led capex as the set-up for the next leg of cargo-volume and EBITDA growth** and reiterate **ADD with a Fair Value of ₹1,900**. [CITE:Kotak|260603|file%3A%2F%2F%2FC%3A%2FUsers%2Fadmin%2FDesktop%2FIndia%2520Related%2520Reports%2FAdani%2520Ports%2520and%2520SEZ%2F%255B260603%255D%2520%255BKotak%255D%2520Adani%2520Ports%2520and%2520SEZ%2520-%2520AR2026%252C%2520Investment%2520engine%2520starting%2520to%2520show%2520its%2520colors.pdf|1]

Nomura flags May-26 cargo traffic at 48mt (up 16% y/y, 12% m/m) — the **eighth straight month of double-digit growth** — driven by container and liquid cargo, reading this as evidence that the **long-term 6-8% structural traffic CAGR assumption is intact** heading into FY27.
